tools.name: vat_rates
tools.description: Return the standard and reduced VAT rates of one country, or the European table when country is omitted. Covers EU-27 plus UK, CH, NO and 17 Latin American countries. Use vat_price to apply a European rate to an amount, latam_iva to calculate Latin American VAT, and vat_validate to check a VAT numbe

tools.name: vat_validate
tools.description: Check whether an EU VAT number is registered in the European Commission's VIES system and return the company name and address when the member state discloses them. Use it to verify a business customer before invoicing. VIES is sometimes unavailable; that returns an error, not 'invalid'. Use validate

tools.name: vat_price
tools.description: Calculate net, VAT amount and gross for a price in one country, applying its standard or reduced rate. Use it for European quotes and invoices; Latin American codes also work. Use vat_rates when you only need the rate. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST /vat/price via x402.

tools.name: fx_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between two of the ~30 currencies published by the European Central Bank (including USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, BRL, MXN), today or on a past date since 1999. Returns rate, converted amount and observation date. For CLP, ARS, COP or PEN use latam_fx or the country tools. Free demo with a d

tools.name: fx_rates
tools.description: Return all European Central Bank reference rates against one base currency, today or on a past date. Use it when you need many rates at once; use fx_convert for a single conversion. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /fx/rates via x402.

tools.name: days_holidays
tools.description: List the official public holidays of a country for a year, with local and English names and whether each is nationwide. Covers the countries supported by Nager.Date. For Chile, cl_feriados uses a curated statutory table and is preferred. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /days/hol

tools.name: days_business_days
tools.description: Return the date that falls N business days after a start date, skipping weekends and the country's public holidays. Use it for deadlines and delivery dates outside Chile; for Chilean legal deadlines use cl_dias_habiles. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /days/business-days via x40

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Check an IBAN's mod-97 check digits and its country-specific length for 88 countries, and return the formatted IBAN and BBAN. Use it to catch typos before a bank transfer; it does not confirm the account exists. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST /validate/iban via x402.

tools.name: validate_phone
tools.description: Check whether a phone number is valid for its region and return its type (mobile, fixed line) and E.164, international and national formats, using Google libphonenumber for ~240 regions. Use it before saving a contact or sending SMS or WhatsApp. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST

tools.name: validate_tax_id
tools.description: Check the format and check digit of a tax ID: RUT (CL), CUIT/CUIL (AR), CPF/CNPJ including alphanumeric CNPJ (BR), RFC (MX), RUC (PE), NIT (CO), NIF/NIE (ES). Use cl_rut for Chile when you also want the normalized format. Does not confirm registration with the tax authority. Free demo with a daily q

tools.name: latam_indexacion
tools.description: Return the official value of a Latin American inflation-indexed unit (UF Chile, UVA Argentina, UVR Colombia, UDI Mexico, UI Uruguay) for today, and optionally convert an amount of units to local currency. Use it for contracts, rents and loans expressed in these units. For UF on a past date or pesos

tools.name: latam_iva
tools.description: Return the VAT rate (IVA, IGV, ITBIS) of one of 17 Latin American countries and, given an amount, calculate net, tax and gross. Omit pais for the full table. Brazil is excluded because it has no single rate. Use vat_price for European countries. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /

tools.name: latam_unidades_tributarias
tools.description: Return the official value of an annual tax unit (UIT Peru, UVT Colombia, UMA Mexico) for a date, with its legal act, and convert N units to local currency. Use it when a fine, fee or tax threshold is stated in these units. For Chile's UTM use cl_indicadores. Free demo with a daily quota; production

tools.name: latam_dolar_argentina
tools.description: Return the Argentine peso's official and blue (parallel market) dollar buy/sell quotes, euro quotes and the official-blue gap percentage, plus MEP, contado con liquidación, mayorista, cripto and tarjeta quotes with their gap against the official rate. Use it for Argentina-specific pricing; use latam

tools.name: latam_fx
tools.description: Return official exchange rates against the US dollar for CLP, ARS (official and blue), BRL (PTAX), MXN (FIX), COP (TRM) and PEN (SBS) in one call, each with its source and date. Use it for multi-country reports; use the country tools for a single currency with more detail. Free demo with a daily quo

tools.name: latam_tasas_politica
tools.description: Return the monetary policy rate of Chile (TPM), Brazil (Selic target), Mexico (target rate), Colombia and Peru, each with its central bank, date and source. Peru publishes a monthly series, so it returns a YYYY-MM period. Partial results list the central banks that did not answer. Free demo with a d

tools.name: br_indices
tools.description: Return Brazil's SELIC target rate, annualized CDI, latest monthly IPCA inflation and PTAX dollar from Banco Central do Brasil. Use it for Brazilian financial indicators; use ar_indices for Argentina. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /br/indices via x402.

tools.name: br_cep
tools.description: Look up a Brazilian postal code (CEP) and return street, neighborhood, city, state and IBGE code. Use it to complete or check a Brazilian address. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /br/cep via x402.

tools.name: br_cnpj
tools.description: Look up a Brazilian company by CNPJ in the Receita Federal open register and return legal and trade name, registration status, opening date, legal nature, size, share capital, main CNAE activity and address. Check digits are validated first, including the alphanumeric CNPJ. Partners and contact data

tools.name: ar_indices
tools.description: Return Argentina's latest monthly inflation, compounded year-over-year inflation and country risk (riesgo país) in basis points. Use it for Argentine price adjustments and reports; use latam_dolar_argentina for exchange rates. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /ar/indices via x402

tools.name: co_trm
tools.description: Return Colombia's TRM, the official COP/USD rate used for taxes and contracts, with its validity dates. Use it for Colombian invoices and declarations. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /co/trm via x402.

tools.name: pe_tipo_cambio
tools.description: Return Peru's official SBS buy and sell exchange rate (PEN per USD) published by the central bank. Use it for Peruvian invoices and accounting. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /pe/tipo-cambio via x402.

tools.name: mx_indicadores
tools.description: Return Mexico's FIX dollar rate by determination date, the rate to settle dollar obligations payable today (dolar_para_pagos: the FIX published in the DOF the previous banking day) and the 28-day TIIE from Banxico. Use dolar_para_pagos for invoices and payments in Mexico; use latam_indexacion for UD

tools.name: cl_reajuste
tools.description: Return Chile's official IPC variation between two months, computed from the INE index levels so it matches the published variation, and optionally apply it to an amount. Use it to update rents, debts or alimony for inflation; use cl_uf when the contract is expressed in UF. Free demo with a daily quo

tools.name: cl_indicadores
tools.description: Return one Chilean economic indicator (UF, UTM, observed dollar, euro, IPC, policy rate TPM, IMACEC, copper price, unemployment rate or IVP) for today or a past date, from official Central Bank and INE data. The UF is published in advance: from the 10th of each month, any date up to the 9th of the n

tools.name: cl_uf
tools.description: Convert an amount from UF to Chilean pesos or back, using the UF value of a given date, and return the UF value, date and source. The UF is published in advance: from the 10th of each month, any date up to the 9th of the next month is available (e.g. on 11 November, the UF of 30 November or 9 Decemb

tools.name: cl_dias_habiles
tools.description: Return the date that falls N business days (días hábiles) after a start date in Chile, skipping weekends and national holidays, and list the holidays skipped. Use it for Chilean legal and administrative deadlines; use days_business_days for other countries. Free demo with a daily quota; production v

tools.name: cl_feriados
tools.description: List Chile's official national holidays for 2026 or 2027 from a curated statutory table, including moved holidays. Prefer it over days_holidays for Chile. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/feriados via x402.

tools.name: cl_rut
tools.description: Check a Chilean RUT's modulo 11 check digit and return it normalized (12.345.678-5). Use it to catch typos before saving a record. Does not confirm the person or company exists with the SII. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST /cl/rut via x402.

tools.name: cl_sueldo_liquido
tools.description: Estimate a Chilean employee's take-home pay from the monthly gross salary, deducting AFP pension, health (Fonasa or Isapre plan), unemployment insurance and impuesto único, with current UF and UTM values. An estimate, not a payroll settlement. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST /c

tools.name: cl_honorarios
tools.description: Calculate a Chilean fee receipt (boleta de honorarios) from gross to net, or the gross to issue for a target net, with the withholding rate of the year under Ley 21.133: 15.25% in 2026, 16% in 2027 and 17% from 2028. Amounts in whole pesos. Use cl_sueldo_liquido for employees with a contract. Free d

tools.name: cl_finiquito
tools.description: Compute a Chilean severance settlement (finiquito): years-of-service indemnity with the 90 UF and 11-year caps, notice-in-lieu, proportional and pending vacation in calendar days, obra o faena scale, unemployment-insurance offset and art. 168 court surcharges. Each item cites its Código del Trabajo

tools.name: cl_costo_empleador
tools.description: Compute the monthly cost of an employee for a Chilean employer: taxable pay with legal gratificación and overtime, plus employer contributions (Ley 21.735 incl. SIS, unemployment insurance, accident insurance, SANNA) with UF ceilings. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/costo-em

tools.name: cl_tasa_maxima
tools.description: Get the CMF's interés corriente and interés máximo convencional in force in Chile on a date (since mid-2019), for every operation type or one code, with the validity window and the official certificate. Use cl_deuda to apply them to a debt between two dates. Free demo with a daily quota; production

tools.name: cl_deuda
tools.description: Compute what a Chilean debt amounts to between its due date and payment: modo=laboral applies Labour Code art. 63/173 (IPC adjustment plus maximum interest for indexed operations); modo=interes applies the CMF corriente or máxima rate in force each day. Returns the breakdown by period. Use cl_tasa_m

tools.name: ar_alquiler
tools.description: Compute an Argentine lease's rent adjustments by ICL, IPC, UVA or CER from official BCRA/INDEC data: each adjustment with factor and new rent, the current rent, the next adjustment and the legal regime of the signing date. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /ar/alquiler via x402.

tools.name: historial
tools.description: Get an official series between two dates (max 5 years): Chile uf, utm, dolar, euro, tpm; Argentina icl, uva, cer, ipc_ar. Returns every observation plus min, max and percent change. Prefer short ranges in chat; use formato=csv over HTTP for long ones. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume:

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vat_validate, validate_iban, validate_phone, validate_tax_id, cl_rut, cl_honorarios, historial · Private data: validate_phone, br_cnpj, cl_rut · Public sink: vat_validate, vat_price, validate_iban, validate_phone, validate_tax_id, br_cnpj, cl_rut, cl_sueldo_liquido · Destructive: vat_validate, validate_tax_id.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vat_validate, validate_iban, validate_phone, validate_tax_id, cl_rut, cl_honorarios, historial · Private data: validate_phone, br_cnpj, cl_rut · Public sink: vat_validate, vat_price, validate_iban, validate_phone, validate_tax_id, br_cnpj, cl_rut, cl_sueldo_liquido · Destructive: vat_validate, validate_tax_id

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
